description: This file defines an API router for handling progress-related endpoints in a FastAPI application. It includes a route for obtaining a summary of tasks, filtered optionally by board or sprint, and computes aggregate task counts and velocity based on task status and story points.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define endpoints related to progress.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to produce a summary of task progress, including total tasks, counts per status, and velocity, with optional filtering parameters.
